trl_basis: No numeric TRL located. IRENA-ETSAP Technology Brief (2015): 'FPC and ETC technology is mature and has enormous potential for low temperature industrial process heat', while 'Most solar thermal systems for industrial process heat are small-scale pilot plants'
key_constraints: UK solar resource limits load factor; land/roof area; intermittency needs storage/backup; concentrating systems poorly suited to UK diffuse light
uk_status: Pilot/niche only in UK
provenance: [IRENA_SHIP2015] Maturity statements without TRL numbers - null per rules

option_name: Regenerative and high-efficiency drives for sortation and conveyors
duty: Regenerative VSDs, IE4/IE5 motors, sleep-mode and cascade control on parcel sorters and conveyor networks, recovering braking energy from frequent stop/start
trl_basis: Commercial per ABB drives literature; no formal TRL published
key_constraints: Savings depend on duty cycle (stop/start and decline sections benefit most); integration with sorter OEM controls
uk_status: Commercial; deployed in logistics and materials-handling applications
provenance: [REF_ABB_REGEN] ABB on regenerative drives converting braking energy to electricity in material handling

option_name: Steel off-gas carbon capture and utilisation to ethanol (Steelanol/LanzaTech)
duty: Gas fermentation of carbon-rich BF/BOF off-gases to ethanol, displacing fossil feedstock and reducing net site CO2
trl_basis: Commercial-flagship Steelanol plant at ArcelorMittal Ghent inaugurated 2022, first ethanol produced 2023 — first-of-a-kind industrial demonstration
key_constraints: Partial abatement only (carbon leaves as product); economics tied to ethanol markets; requires steady off-gas supply; project economics reported uncertain
uk_status: No UK installation; applicability shrinking with BF closures
provenance: [REF_STEELANOL] ArcelorMittal Europe press release on Steelanol CCU inauguration at Ghent

option_name: Thermal vapour recompression (thermocompression) on stills and evaporators
duty: Steam-jet recompression of still/evaporator vapours to cut live steam demand in distillation and co-product evaporation
trl_basis: No formal published TRL located; long-established engineering practice in distillery energy papers (Briggs/Davies) with installations dating to the 1980s
key_constraints: Needs motive steam pressure; lower savings than MVR; still leaves residual fossil steam demand unless boiler fuel switched
uk_status: Established practice in grain distilleries and dark-grains evaporators; retrofit option for malt distilleries
provenance: [BRIGGS_DAVIES] Briggs of Burton technical paper on distillery energy discusses vapour recompression on stills; MVR precedent at Auchroisk (1986)

option_name: Superheated steam drying of beet pulp and wet co-products
duty: Pressurised superheated steam dryers replacing HT gas-fired rotary dryers; evaporated water recovered as usable steam
trl_basis: No formal TRL; multiple full-scale industrial installations internationally (EnerDry steam dryers in beet sugar); first UK unit under construction
key_constraints: High capex (~£50m at Wissington); integration with factory steam balance; campaign operation; product colour/quality
uk_status: British Sugar Wissington £50m steam dryer project launched 2025 as its biggest decarbonisation project; commercial in EU/US beet sugar
provenance: [BSUGAR_WISSINGTON] British Sugar Wissington steam dryer announcement; EnerDry industrial steam drying references

option_name: Superheated steam drying of paper web
duty: Dry paper web in superheated steam atmosphere enabling near-total latent heat recovery (with MVR)
trl_basis: Paper-web SSD demonstrated only at lab/pilot scale; SSD industrial in other sectors (Drying Technology review, 2015)
key_constraints: Sheet quality, web entry/exit sealing, full dryer-section redesign; never demonstrated at machine scale
uk_status: No UK activity identified
provenance: [ssd_review_2015] Review of pilot and industrial superheated steam dryers incl. paper status

option_name: Cable-tethered electric excavators and face shovels
duty: Electric excavation/loading at the face via trailing HV cable
trl_basis: Series products offered for mine and quarry extraction (e.g. Liebherr R 9200 E; HeavyQuip, 2021)
key_constraints: Trailing cable limits mobility; HV distribution to face required; suits benched, slowly-advancing faces
uk_status: Commercially available; limited UK quarry uptake to date
provenance: [REF_HEAVYQUIP21] OEM launch of electric excavators explicitly for mine/quarry extraction

option_name: Top-gas recycling blast furnace with CO2 capture (ULCOS TGR-BF)
duty: BF operating on recycled decarbonated top gas with oxygen injection, CO2 removed and sent to storage; ~50-60% CO2 reduction with CCS
trl_basis: Piloted at LKAB experimental BF, Lulea under ULCOS (EU-published final report); never demonstrated at industrial scale — planned Florange demo cancelled
key_constraints: Major BF rebuild (oxygen operation, gas separation); needs CO2 transport and storage; industrial demonstration gap since 2014
uk_status: Not pursued in UK; BF fleet closure removes the application
provenance: [REF_ULCOS] EU Publications Office final report on ULCOS top gas recycling blast furnace process

option_name: High-temperature thermal storage charged with electricity (power-to-heat + storage)
duty: Stores cheap/renewable electricity as heat (bricks/salts/steel) discharging steam or hot air up to several hundred C, enabling flexible electrified heat
trl_basis: Agora Industry/Fraunhofer ISI (2024): combined thermal storage 'Technology readiness level 7-9' - small-scale industrial application exists; further development needed for higher temperatures/capacities
key_constraints: Grid connection sized for charging; space and weight; economics depend on electricity price spreads/flex markets; few UK references
uk_status: Demonstration internationally (e.g. Rondo, Kraftblock); pilot interest in UK
provenance: [AGORA2024] TRL table, thermal storage entry

option_name: Trolley-assist (overhead catenary) electric haul truck haulage
duty: Electric-drive haul trucks drawing grid power on catenary-equipped haul ramps
trl_basis: Commercial systems operating at multiple mines worldwide (Komatsu, Hitachi, Wabtec; International Mining, 2024)
key_constraints: Needs large electric-drive trucks, fixed haul routes and MW-scale supply; economics require deep pits/long ramps
uk_status: No known UK deployments; scale mismatch with most UK quarries
provenance: [REF_IM_WABTEC24] OEM/industry review of trolley assist for mine haulage decarbonisation

option_name: ULT freezer optimisation (-70C setpoints, consolidation)
duty: -70C setpoints, maintenance, consolidation and efficient replacement of ultra-low temperature freezers
trl_basis: Commercial practice; CDC case study documented in I2SL Smart Labs Toolkit
key_constraints: Sample integrity governance; behavioural measure needing ongoing management
uk_status: Promoted via LEAF and freezer challenges across UK institutions
provenance: [cdc_ult_case] I2SL case study of ULT freezer optimisation at CDC

option_name: UV-cured coatings
duty: Ultraviolet-cured coatings replacing thermally-baked coatings for parts, plastics, refinish and potentially body primer/clearcoat, eliminating cure-oven heat
trl_basis: RadTech describes UV curing as commercially established across many industrial coating applications; no formal TRL published for automotive body duty
key_constraints: Line-of-sight cure limits complex 3D geometries (mitigated by dual-cure chemistries); coating requalification; UV safety; commercial for flat/small parts, not proven for full body-in-white
uk_status: Commercial for industrial parts, wood, plastics and refinish; automotive body application at development/demonstration stage
provenance: [REF_RADTECH] RadTech overview of UV/EB curing process, markets and energy benefits

option_name: Ventilation air methane (VAM) thermal oxidation
duty: Regenerative thermal oxidation of dilute methane in mine ventilation air, optionally with heat recovery
trl_basis: Commercial/demonstration units operated at Australian and Chinese mines (CSIRO; WestVAMP)
key_constraints: Very dilute methane; safety integration with ventilation circuit; no operating UK deep coal mines to apply it to
uk_status: Not applicable to current UK operations except legacy shafts; speculative
provenance: [REF_CSIRO_VAM] CSIRO programme page on VAM abatement technology

option_name: Warm mix asphalt (lower-temperature asphalt production)
duty: Reduce mixing/drying temperature by ~20-40C via additives/foaming, cutting burner fuel use
trl_basis: Commercially deployed; Highways England/National Highways made warm mix the default expectation for its network (2021)
key_constraints: Client specification uptake beyond strategic roads; binder/additive selection; some mixes still require hot production
uk_status: Commercial; National Highways default position, offered by all major UK producers
provenance: [R_WMA] Construction Index report on Highways England directing contractors to warm mix asphalt

option_name: Waste-derived fuels (RDF/SRF, MBM, waste biomass) in kilns and furnaces
duty: High-temperature kiln fuel (cement/lime) and co-firing; partial decarbonisation (biogenic fraction only)
trl_basis: No published numeric TRL located. Commercial practice in UK cement (~40%+ thermal substitution); DESNZ IFS Phase 3 funds MPA 'State-of-the-Art Fuel Mix for UK Cement Production' (biomass, hydrogen and electricity mix) as demonstration
key_constraints: Waste permitting and emissions limits; fuel quality variability; chlorine/ash chemistry effects; only biogenic share counts as low-carbon; feedstock competition with EfW
uk_status: Deployed (cement sector routine); 100% net-zero fuel-mix demonstrated at Ribblesdale under MPA/DESNZ programme
provenance: [DESNZ_IFS3_2022] Project description for MPA fuel-mix demo; TRL null per rules

option_name: Waste heat recovery to process (economisers, recuperators, heat exchangers)
duty: Recovery of flue-gas/process waste heat for preheating combustion air, feedwater, product or other site heat loads
trl_basis: No formal published TRL located for generic heat-exchanger-based WHR; universally described as established commercial practice (e.g. funded as mature deployment under DESNZ IETF)
key_constraints: Site-specific heat source/sink matching; space and pipework; fouling/corrosive flue gases; economics depend on load coincidence
uk_status: Deployed widely; further potential remains (IETF-funded projects)
provenance: [DESNZ_IFS3_2022] TRL null - conventional WHR predates and sits outside TRL frameworks; flagged in challenges. Reference given only for programme context

option_name: Wettable/drained TiB2 cathodes for aluminium cells
duty: TiB2-coated drained cathodes reduce anode-cathode distance and cell voltage, cutting electrolysis energy ~10-20%
trl_basis: US DOE pilot programmes (OSTI technical reports) and a 2022 Journal of Sustainable Metallurgy review conclude wettable cathodes remain at pilot/retrofit-trial stage, not commercial
key_constraints: Coating durability and cost; cell magnetohydrodynamic stability at low ACD; retrofit complexity
uk_status: No UK activity
provenance: [REF_TIB2] Springer review of wettable TiB2 cathodes for aluminium electrolysis

option_name: Wort boiling vapour recovery (vapour condenser, energy store, TVR/MVR kettle)
duty: Recovery/recompression of wort kettle vapours to preheat wort or regenerate kettle heat, cutting brewhouse steam demand
trl_basis: No formal TRL published; offered commercially by major brewhouse suppliers (Steinecker energy-recovery systems) and described by Campden BRI as established practice
key_constraints: Retrofit space and kettle design; savings depend on evaporation rate; MVR variant needs electrical capacity
uk_status: Commercially available and applied in UK breweries; standard on modern brewhouses
provenance: [CAMPDEN_WORT] Campden BRI sustainable brewing guidance on recovery of energy from wort boiling vapour; Steinecker commercial systems

option_name: Adsorption (zeolite) assisted low-temperature drying
duty: Zeolite-dehumidified air enables low-temperature drying of heat-sensitive powders with sorbent regeneration heat recovery
trl_basis: No published TRL; academic multistage zeolite drying studies (WUR) report modelling/pilot-scale work for heat-sensitive food products
key_constraints: Early stage for dairy/food powders; sorbent regeneration energy; scale-up and hygiene design unproven
uk_status: No known UK industrial deployment; research/pilot stage
provenance: [ZEOLITE_WUR] Wageningen UR work on energy-efficient multistage zeolite drying for heat-sensitive products
